									<h6>ABOUT</h6><h1>PANDANUS</h1>								</div>

						<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-be6da77 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="be6da77" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									Imagine yourself in Paradise. Imagine yourself in Pandanus; a resort in harmony with both nature and the rich local culture.
Welcome to a refreshing retreat! Palm trees and lush tropical flora surround you. Designed in the charming Cham architectural style, this peaceful getaway will comfort you and transport you to a place of serenity and beauty.
Imagine the sound of the ocean waves whispering in your ear and providing the perfect backdrop for relaxation. In the heart of this serene paradise, amidst the beauty that surrounds you, don’t forget to explore local traditions and culture.								</div>
				</div>
					</div>

				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									<h6>RESORT HIGHLIGHT</h6><h2>Cham Culture</h2><p>Our charming Cham-style buildings and extensive native landscape are designed to complement, not compete with, the natural surroundings. We have two large free-form swimming pools. The Orchid Swimming Pool next to our beach has an island in the centre covered with palm trees. The Garden Swimming Pool has a swim-up bar built into it. Throughout our gardens are small streams, ponds with lotus blossoms, water lilies, colourful tropical plants and displays of Cham cultural icons that invite you to wander and explore.</p>								</div>
